'''Chezdeze''' was an establishment on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], located in [[Slum district G17/Legends|Slum district G17]], in the same building as the [[Trueping's/Legends|Trueping's]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] and an unnamed [[Unidentified massage parlor/Legends|massage parlor]]. A neon sign on the façade showed the name of the establishment, written in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]]. An "open" sign signaled when the business was ready to receive customers or visitors.<ref name="Lightsaber Lost" />
